Package edu.odu.cs.cs350

Class ProjectionReader

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.ProjectionReader
public class ProjectionReader extends Object
ProjectionReader; Reads semester directories and creates the proper nesting of Semesters - Snapshots - Courses - Offerings - Sections

    • readSemesterDirectory

      public static ArrayList<Semester> readSemesterDirectory(ArrayList<Path> semesterDirectories, LocalDate cutoffDate) throws IOException
      Builds the core data structure of this program.
      Parameters:
      semesterDirectories - directories containing semester data
      cutoffDate - for the last semester
      Returns:
      a list of semesters, each populated with a nesting of Snapshots, Courses, Offerings, and Sections
      Throws:
      IOException - in case of a missing dates.txt file and other I/O related processing

    • createSection

      public static Section createSection(String[] fields, HashMap<String,Integer> headersToColumns) throws NumberFormatException
      Forms a section IMPORTANT: If there is no provided cap; this means the course is sole offering, thus we assign cap to XLSTCAP, since this is the only cap of enrollment for the implicit section - offering pair.
      Parameters:
      fields - the csv fields we are drawing our section from
      headersToColumns - mapping from header labels to column rows
      Returns:
      a fully formed section
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - when we fail parse a field we expect to be numeric

    • chooseCutoff

      public static LocalDate chooseCutoff(boolean isLastSemester, LocalDate semesterCutoff, LocalDate addDeadlineDate)
      Logic for choosing cutoff date for semesters Core Implementation of User Story [ Command Line Input : Cutoff Date ]
      Parameters:
      isLastSemester - if the dates belong to the last semester, the one we are projecting
      semesterCutoff - the semester cutoff actually applied to the semester, initialized from CLI input
      addDeadlineDate - the add deadline, initialized from dates.txt
      Returns:
      the proper cutoff

      Forms courses from the appropriate sole-section and multi-section offerings.
